name: tuya-local
description: Control Tuya / Smart Life lights over your LAN: a /light command, red/green signals when tests or builds fail and recover, and an optional ambient mood mode.

signals.title: Build/test signals
signals.description: Turn the lights red when a test or build fails, then flash green and restore them when it passes again.

signal_target.title: Signal lights
signal_target.description: Which lights show the red/green signal: all, or a light's zone or name (comma-separated for several), e.g. setup.

signal_commands.title: Signal commands (regex)
signal_commands.description: Optional regular expression for the commands that count as tests or builds. Leave empty for the built-in list (pytest, npm test, cargo build, go test, make, ...).

ambient.title: Ambient mood
ambient.description: Let Claude set the room mood on its own (focus while debugging, chill late at night). Adds a short instruction to each session.
